shorts.title: What you will learn: Type conversion and casting
shorts.hook: A double can lose its decimals without any error.
shorts.script: A double can lose its decimals without any error. Today we mix types. Sometimes C plus plus changes a type for you. You must know when, and what is lost. C plus plus converts types when you mix them. An int becomes a double with no loss. A double becomes an int by cutting off the decimals. It does not round. Keep coding, says Xecxec!
shorts.caption: What you will learn: Type conversion and casting.

shorts.title: Type conversion and casting in one minute
shorts.hook: C plus plus converts types when you mix them.
shorts.script: C plus plus converts types when you mix them. An int becomes a double with no loss. A double becomes an int by cutting off the decimals. It does not round. A cast is a clear request to convert. In modern C plus plus, we write static cast. Think of a jug and a small glass. Pour the jug into the glass, and some water is lost. Keep coding, says Xecxec!
shorts.onScreen: TYPE CONVERSION AND CASTING IN ONE MINUTE
shorts.caption: Type conversion and casting in one minute.

shorts.title: Inside the second program
shorts.hook: We have seven passed students out of eight.
shorts.script: We have seven passed students out of eight. We cast passed to a double first. Then the division keeps the decimals. The answer is zero point eight seven five. Here we cast the letter A to an int. It prints sixty-five. That is the code of the letter A. The program prints zero point eight seven five, and then sixty-five. Keep coding, says Xecxec!
shorts.caption: Inside the second program.

shorts.title: Bug of the Day: Casting too late
shorts.script: Bug of the Day. We cast the result of the division. The program prints zero. Why? Seven divided by eight is zero in int maths. The cast comes too late. Put the cast on one number, before the division. Then the answer is zero point eight seven five. Seven divided by eight is already zero when both are ints. Keep coding, says Xecxec!
shorts.onScreen: BUG OF THE DAY: CASTING TOO LATE
shorts.caption: Bug of the Day: Casting too late.

shorts.title: Pun and challenge
shorts.hook: I tried to cast a spell on my double. It lost its decimals and its magic.
shorts.script: I tried to cast a spell on my double. It lost its decimals and its magic. Store three int marks. Print their average as a double with decimals. Write your answer in the comments. C plus plus converts types for you. A double becomes an int by cutting the decimals. Use static cast to convert on purpose. Cast one number before you divide. Keep coding, says Xecxec!
shorts.caption: Pun and challenge.
